R2: a response refused after fetch (undeclared final origin, unverifiable redirect, failed artifact download) is cancelled. AWAI-325: explicit literal-IP/PeerID/protocol/byte/deadline-scoped libp2p host endpoints; canonical fresh consent, immutable payload/handler capture, cancellation and bounded responses; no HTTP origin fabrication or CSP widening. AWAI-3307: artifacts may declare `delivery: 'host-stream'` (byte budget up to 64 GiB).
